detail.other_findings: About 120 records reviewed; common problems were lack of pain analysis, missed neuropathic pain and opioid underdosing.

title: A real-time audit of radiation therapy in a regional cancer center.
standard: Peer review approval of radiotherapy plans and treatment policies
finding: 124 (4.1%) plans not approved for planning errors, 79% of which were modified before treatment; 110 (3.6%) not approved for policy deviations.

detail.setting: Kingston Regional Cancer Center

cycle1.result: 124 (4.1%) plans not approved for planning errors, 79% of which were modified before treatment; 110 (3.6%) not approved for policy deviations.

detail.other_findings: Only 22% of policy-deviation plans were modified before treatment.
